Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert fired for billing-metering-ingestion. Service: usage-ingest-pipeline. Severity: P1 :rotating_light:

PagerDuty: Incident created: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/P12345

Alex Chen: acked oncall. Heading in.

Priya Patel: seeing increased ack latency on stream-consumer-02, queued msgs ~28k

Ben Rosario: confirmed. Consumer lag spiked at 17:20 UTC, partition 5/12. Reprocessing backlog = 2.1M tokens

Sasha Kline: customer billing jobs for 2026-03 invoices are hitting the aggregator with incomplete token counts. Some invoices may be short.

Alex Chen: @oncall-ingestion can you run `kubectl get pods -n billing-ingest -o wide` and check restarts? Also paste runbook link.

oncall-ingestion: running

oncall-ingestion: pods OK, no restarts. Backpressure looks like Kafka consumer lag. Attaching consumer-lag output:
```
consumer_group: billing-ingest-group
partition 5: lag=28000
partition 6: lag=0
partition 7: lag=32000
```

Priya Patel: looks like a skewed partition. Might need to reassign or restart consumer 02

Ben Rosario: scaling consumers now: `./infra/scripts/scale-consumer --replicas 6 --group billing-ingest-group` will spin up extra pods

Sasha Kline: heads up — if we scale we might duplicate counts vs. at-least-once semantics — need to pause aggregator during backfill

Alex Chen: Good call. Initiating safe pause on aggregator

Alex Chen: `POST /admin/aggregator/pause` -> status 202

PagerDuty: User Alex Chen acknowledged the incident at 1749001300

Ben Rosario: scaled to 6 replicas, new consumers joined at 17:28 UTC

oncall-ingestion: consumer lag decreasing. partition5: 5k, partition7: 6k

Priya Patel: starting replay for missing ranges from offset 120,000 to 180,000

Sasha Kline: starting billing recount from safe checkpoint. ETA ~18m

Dave O'Leary: flagged impacted customers list and billing team notified. escalation to finance if not resolved within 1 hour

Alex Chen: monitoring metrics: ingestion-rate -> 15k tokens/s, aggregator-error-rate -> 0.02

Ben Rosario: by 17:45 lag down to under 500. Replays finished.

Sasha Kline: aggregator resumed: `POST /admin/aggregator/resume` -> status 200

Priya Patel: verifying token counts against checkpoints — diff reduced from 2.1M to 4k

Sasha Kline: doing final checksum, looks good. invoices generation unblocked. No customer-facing invoice divergence expected beyond delayed processing window

Alex Chen: closing PagerDuty incident P12345. Please post postmortem link when available.

PagerDuty: Incident P12345 resolved at 1749004560

Incident Bot: Noted. Closing Slack thread. Reminder: create incident ticket and link runbook updates.
